headline: KEC International wins T&D orders of ₹1,014 crore
summary: KEC International secured new T&D orders worth ₹1,014 crore in India, taking its YTD order intake to over ₹9,600 crore.

headline: Viviana Power Tech wins ₹466.74 crore MGVCL contracts
summary: Viviana Power Tech secured turnkey contracts worth ₹466.74 crore from MGVCL for power distribution network upgrades. The company's market capitalisation stands at ₹830 crore.

headline: Hazoor Multi Projects wins ₹77.60 crore NHAI contracts
summary: Hazoor Multi Projects secured NHAI user fee collection contracts worth ₹77.60 crore in Karnataka, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Bajel Projects wins EPC order worth ₹200 crore+
summary: Bajel Projects secures a major EPC order worth over ₹200 crore for 220kV GIS substations at Salsette and Powai in Mumbai.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins ₹290.23 crore railway order
summary: Ashoka Buildcon received a Letter of Acceptance from North Eastern Railway for a ₹290.23 crore project involving design, supply, erection, testing, and commissioning of traction sub stations, with a 24-month completion period.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Poonawalla, KEC, Blue Dart in focus
summary: Poonawalla Fincorp surges on stellar Q2 earnings, while KEC International rallies on fresh T&D orders. Blue Dart expands reach via India Post MoU.

headline: Power Grid launches Rajasthan renewable energy project
summary: Power Grid Corporation of India launches a project in Rajasthan designed to handle 20 GW of renewable energy, marking a significant step in India's clean energy transmission infrastructure.

headline: HG Infra forms Section 8 subsidiary for PM-Setu ITI Bhwadi
summary: HG Infra Engineering has incorporated a Section 8 subsidiary with a 51% shareholding to execute the PM-Setu ITI Bhwadi project.

headline: Lord's Mark Industries acquires Radiotone to boost transformer capacity
summary: Lord's Mark Industries Limited acquired Radio Electric Private Limited (Radiotone) to gain specialised transformer technology and export capabilities. The deal adds a debt-free business with 50% capacity utilisation headroom.

headline: Rupee opens at 95.76 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.76 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 96.73, reflecting a stronger opening for the domestic currency.

headline: UBS maintains Buy on CarTrade, target ₹4,000
summary: UBS maintains a Buy rating on CarTrade Tech with a target price of ₹4,000, citing improved OLX India profitability and underestimated growth potential across multiple revenue streams.

headline: CLSA sees RBI measures supporting rupee near term
summary: CLSA expects RBI's tighter cash-reserve maintenance, ₹250bn OMO sale, dedicated OMC dollar window and FX restrictions to support the rupee near term, with attention later shifting to capital flows and crude oil.

headline: Swan Defence to secure ₹1,897 crore tanker order
summary: Swan Defence & Heavy Industries is set to secure a ₹1,897 crore order for four oil product tankers, marking a significant contract win in the defence and shipbuilding sector.

headline: Lenskart Solutions block trade of ₹112.91 crore on NSE
summary: Lenskart Solutions saw a block trade of ₹112.91 crore on the NSE, involving approximately 1,745,143 shares at a price of ₹647.00 per share.

headline: Mold-Tek Packaging allots 3.32 crore bonus shares
summary: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited allotted 3,32,28,914 bonus equity shares in a 1:1 ratio on October 12, 2026. The paid-up capital doubles to ₹33.23 crore post-issue.

headline: ICICI Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 10,03,167 ICICI Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,349.60, with a combined value of ₹135.39 crore.

headline: IRB Infra raises toll collection forecast to 24%
summary: IRB Infrastructure has revised its toll collection forecast upward from 20% to 24%, signalling stronger-than-expected traffic and revenue momentum across its road portfolio.

headline: Rajesh Power Services secures ₹472 crore order
summary: Rajesh Power Services has secured a new order valued at ₹472 crore. The company's market capitalisation stands at ₹1,400 crore.

headline: Religare shares see ₹51 crore large trade
summary: Large trade signal flags ~2.4 lakh Religare shares changing hands near ₹216. Total value approx ₹51.83 crore. Not a confirmed block deal.

headline: India's coal stocks at power plants stay above 18 million tonnes
summary: India's Coal Ministry reports that coal stocks at power plants remain steady above 18 million tonnes, signalling stable fuel inventory levels at thermal generation facilities.

headline: Can Fin Homes to pass on 12-13 bps of 25 bps rate cut
summary: Can Fin Homes says it will pass on 12-13 bps to customers out of the 25 bps rate reduction, signalling a partial transmission of the rate benefit.

headline: IDBI Bank strategic sale delayed amid market uncertainty
summary: The strategic sale of IDBI Bank has been delayed, with any fresh stake sales now contingent on prevailing market conditions, adding uncertainty to the disinvestment timeline.

headline: Dixon: Mobile phone festive volume falls 12%
summary: Mobile phone volumes for Dixon Technologies are estimated to have declined 12% during the first three days of the festive season, signalling a weak start to the period.

headline: Hindustan Copper appoints Abhimanue Singh as ED, MCP
summary: Hindustan Copper Limited announced the appointment of Abhimanue Singh as Executive Director and Unit Head of the Malanjkhand Copper Project, effective October 11, 2026.

headline: ICICI Bank shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 502,993 ICICI Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,344.20, with a combined value of ₹67.61 crore.

headline: Indian Hotels sees demand outstrip supply
summary: Indian Hotels Company reports demand surpassing supply, expecting strong growth next quarter with over 15% revenue growth anticipated in the second half.

headline: Axis Bank block trade: ₹50.15 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 4,01,258 shares of Axis Bank was executed on BSE at ₹1,249.80 per share, amounting to ₹50.15 crore.

headline: Tata Power Renewables logs 130% YoY growth in Q2FY27
summary: TPREL commissioned 419 MW of utility-scale capacity and 131.2 MWhr of storage in Q2FY27, marking over 130% YoY growth. Total operational capacity now stands at 7.2 GW.

headline: Emcure board approves merger of two subsidiaries
summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals approved a draft scheme to merge wholly owned subsidiaries Zuventus Healthcare and Emcutix Biopharmaceuticals into the parent company.

headline: AceVector: Snapdeal festive sale sees 59% growth
summary: Snapdeal's Swagotsav sale recorded 59% growth in fashion units and 63% rise in buyers. Active sellers jumped 94%, with 82% of orders from non-metro cities.

headline: Snapdeal's Swagotsav sale sees 59% growth in fashion units
summary: Acevector's Snapdeal platform recorded a 59% rise in fashion units sold during its Swagotsav sale, with fashion customers up 63% led by Gen Z and 82% of orders from outside metros.

headline: Chase Bright Steel appoints Ritu Khandelwal as CS
summary: Chase Bright Steel Ltd appointed Ritu Khandelwal as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 12, 2026, following a board meeting.

headline: Coal India block trade of ₹65.08 crore on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 1,603,661 shares of Coal India was executed on the NSE at ₹405.80 per share, aggregating to ₹65.08 crore.

headline: Embassy Developments allots warrants to promoter
summary: Embassy Developments Limited allotted 3.25 crore convertible warrants to promoter group at ₹111.51 each, raising ₹90.65 crore upfront.

headline: Taneja Aerospace acquires TAAL Precision for ₹1,000
summary: Taneja Aerospace & Aviation Ltd acquired 100% stake in TAAL Precision Products Pvt. Ltd. for ₹1,000 to boost aerospace manufacturing. The target is a newly incorporated entity with no operating history.

headline: Jubilant Pharmova shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 200,560 shares of Jubilant Pharmova changing hands on NSE at ₹911.60 per share, with a combined value of ₹18.28 crore.

headline: Raymond expands capacity in Andhra Pradesh
summary: Raymond is constructing a new facility adjacent to its existing mega manufacturing unit in Andhra Pradesh, with the greenfield project reported to be on track.

headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank debt securities outstanding
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported ₹4,695 crore in outstanding debt securities as on September 30, 2026. The filing details four bond series with coupons ranging from 7.55% to 7.85%.

headline: First Fintec cites no RPTs, skips SEBI disclosure
summary: First Fintec Limited notified BSE that Regulation 23(9) disclosures are not applicable as the company reports on a standalone basis with no related party transactions.

headline: Share India appoints Kalpesh Dave as President
summary: Share India Securities appoints Kalpesh Dave as President-Wealth Management and Senior Management Personnel effective October 12, 2026.

headline: Canara Robeco Asset confirms 35-40 bps yield guidance
summary: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company has confirmed its yield guidance at 35-40 bps, with equity yields at around 40 bps, debt yields at about 28 bps, and liquid funds yielding approximately 2 bps.

headline: Lumino Industries secures order worth ₹496 crore
summary: Lumino Industries has secured a new order valued at ₹496 crore, marking a significant business development for the company.

headline: Mehul Telecom opens 3 new retail stores in Gujarat
summary: Mehul Telecom Limited expanded its retail footprint by opening three franchise stores in Morbi, Ahmedabad, and Chikhli, Gujarat, on October 11 and 12, 2026.

headline: Chatha Foods submits revised EGM voting results
summary: Chatha Foods Ltd filed revised voting results for its EGM held on September 29, 2026. All four ordinary resolutions passed with 100% support from polled votes.

headline: Westlife Foodworld launches Spicy Patakha Range
summary: Westlife Foodworld Ltd. introduced the Spicy Patakha Range for McDonald's India (West & South) on October 12, 2026. The festive menu features paneer and chicken burgers starting at ₹199.

headline: Puravankara signs JDA for 12.76-acre Bengaluru land
summary: Puravankara signed a JDA for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur, North Bengaluru, with an estimated GDV of ₹2,500 crore and saleable area of approximately 1.90 million sq ft.

headline: Shraddha Prime books ₹60 Cr on Pandora launch
summary: Shraddha Prime Projects launched 'Pandora by Shraddha' in Mumbai, securing ₹60 crore in bookings on day one. The 22-storey project has a GDV of ₹220 crore.

headline: Swaraj Engines Q2 net profit rises to ₹606 million
summary: Swaraj Engines reported a net profit of ₹606 million for Q2, up from ₹497 million YoY. Revenue grew to ₹6.4 billion with EBITDA margins holding steady at 13.6%.

headline: Nuvoco marks 10 years with 35 MMTPA target
summary: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation celebrates a decade of growth, targeting 35 MMTPA cement capacity by FY28. Current operating capacity stands at 27 MMTPA.

headline: Mastek wins ISG Paragon award for CORT partnership
summary: Mastek and CORT Business Services won the 2026 ISG Paragon Partnership of the Year for North America, recognizing a decade-long digital transformation collaboration.

headline: Chatha Foods shares listed after warrant conversion
summary: Chatha Foods Ltd received BSE trading approval for 16,000 equity shares allotted via warrant conversion. The listing is effective October 12, 2026.

headline: Goodluck India expands restructuring to include two subsidiaries
summary: Goodluck India Ltd board approved in-principle enlargement of corporate restructuring scope. The plan now includes amalgamation of Goodluck Defence and Aerospace and Goodluck Green Energy into the parent company.

headline: Centrum Capital promoter pledges 4.81 crore shares
summary: Business Match Services pledged 4.81 crore Centrum Capital shares to three lenders due to market price fluctuations, raising total encumbered holdings to 9.66%.

headline: Orient Electric to host Q2FY27 earnings call on Oct 15
summary: Orient Electric Limited will discuss its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in an earnings call scheduled for October 15, 2026.

headline: SMT IPO: ₹1,210 Cr Revenue; 25% DES Share
summary: Sahajanand Medical Technologies files DRHP for a pure Offer for Sale. The Surat-based medtech firm reports FY26 revenue of ₹1,210.50 crore and holds ~25% market share in India's Drug-Eluting Stent segment.

headline: Popular Vehicles to host Citi analyst call Oct 15
summary: Popular Vehicles and Services Ltd will hold a virtual group meeting with investors and analysts organized by Citi Research on October 15, 2026, at 1:00 pm IST.

headline: Fairchem to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: Fairchem Organics will hold a conference call on October 23, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST to discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results.

headline: PNB appoints Sushil Katara as director
summary: Punjab National Bank has appointed Sushil Katara as a Part-Time Non-Official Director effective October 9, 2026. The appointment was notified to stock exchanges under SEBI regulations.

headline: Delhivery wins Golden Peacock Award for Corporate Governance 2026
summary: Delhivery has been recognized as the winner of the Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance 2026 in the Logistics sector by the Institute of Directors, India.

headline: Fortis Healthcare reports ₹1,550 crore debt securities
summary: Fortis Healthcare Limited disclosed details of listed debt securities issued via private placement as on September 30, 2026. The total outstanding amount stands at ₹1,550 crore with a coupon rate of 7.7648% for the first year.

headline: MTNL shareholders adopt FY26 financials at 40th AGM
summary: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd shareholders adopted the audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY26 with 99.99% support. Key resolutions included reappointments and auditor remuneration fixes.

headline: JK Paper appoints Gunjan Shah as President (Paper)
summary: JK Paper has appointed Gunjan Shah as President (Paper). Shah previously served as MD & CEO of Bata India and held a senior role at Britannia Industries.

headline: GHCL commences bromine production at 2800 MT capacity
summary: GHCL has commenced commercial production of bromine with an annual capacity of 2800 MT, targeting both domestic and international markets.

headline: Sancode appoints Jerry A. Agnes as CEO of Sancode Semi
summary: Sancode Technologies appoints Jerry A. Agnes, ex-CG Semi CEO, to lead its new OSAT facility in Odisha. Agnes brings 35 years of global semiconductor experience.

headline: Dr Lal PathLabs invests in subsidiary for CentraPath stake
summary: Dr Lal PathLabs invested in subsidiary PathLabs Unifiers to acquire remaining 30% of CentraPath Labs. The transaction, valued at up to ₹30.3 crore, makes CentraPath a wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: Garg Furnace allots 13.98 lakh warrants at ₹126.50
summary: Garg Furnace Ltd board approved allotment of 13,98,000 warrants convertible into equity shares on a preferential basis. The issue price is ₹126.50 per warrant, aggregating to ₹17.68 crore.

headline: Triveni Power Transmission files UPSI disclosure code
summary: Triveni Power Transmission Limited has submitted its Code of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information to stock exchanges under SEBI PIT Regulations, 2015.

headline: Alkali Metals Q2FY27: Turns profitable
summary: Alkali Metals Ltd reported a net profit of ₹57.57 lakh in Q2FY27, swinging from a loss. Revenue rose 45% YoY to ₹2,726.59 lakh, driven by export growth.

headline: Sangam Health appoints T. Abhilash as CS
summary: Sangam Health Care Products Ltd appointed T. Abhilash as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 12, 2026. He is an associate member of ICSI.

headline: Gem Enviro revises deal to buy 26% in Solluz
summary: Gem Enviro Management Ltd revised its share subscription agreement to acquire a 26% stake in Solluz Energy for ₹5.28 crore, up from ₹5.07 crore.

headline: RGF Capital Markets open offer opens at ₹1.10
summary: RGF Capital Markets Ltd open offer for 26% equity at ₹1.10 per share has opened. The offer includes interest due to RBI approval delays, with a revised timeline extending to November 2026.

headline: SKM Egg board to meet Oct 23 for Q2FY27 results
summary: SKM Egg Products Export will hold a board meeting on October 23, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 financials and the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary.

headline: Govt tells SC: India has lowest medicine prices
summary: The government told the Supreme Court it does not wish to control the entire range of drugs and noted that India has among the lowest medicine prices globally.

headline: Mukul Agarwal holds 1.33% stake in Tega Industries Q2
summary: Investor Mukul Agarwal holds a 1.33% stake in Tega Industries for Q2, according to the latest shareholding data.
